pages.text: Once all components are in, right-click with $(item)cylinders$() until every slot is filled (goggles: $(item)Pistons Missing$() or $(item)Turbines Missing$() until then). The cylinder decides which fuels the engine burns; its tooltip lists them under $(item)Supported Fuels$().

$(li)$(item)Diesel Engine Cylinder$() (4 aluminium sheets): diesel.$(li)$(item)Engine Cylinder$() (diesel cylinder + Spark Plug): gasoline, kerosene, naphtha.$(li)$(item)Engine Cylinder$() + Brass Pipe: LPG.$(li)Engine Cylinder filled by a spout with 250 mB of $(item)butane$(), $(item)propane$() or $(item)hydrogen$(): that gas.
$(li)$(item)Simple Engine Cylinder$() (4 iron sheets + Flint and Steel): creosote and furnace gas.$(li)$(item)Turbine Blade$() (8 iron sheets + Shaft): kerosene. Turbine engines only take blades.

The fuel list is read from the cylinders, so keep one kind per engine; an Engine Cylinder whose fuels differ from those already inside is refused. Changing the engine type hands the cylinders back to you.
